Name: Asahel, Son of Zeruiah
Summary: Son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, and one of David's valiant men.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:16; 1 Chronicles 11:26: Son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, and one of David's valiant men.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Asahel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
